title: Dynamics 365 Business Central 2025 Wave 2. What’s New in Performance.
summary: Version 27 of Dynamics 365 Business Central introduces six performance enhancements across application, development, and SQL optimization areas, including optimized flow fields, SQL statements in AL profiles, and new AL functions like LockTimeoutDuration and CreateSequentialGuid.
key_points: The author highlights six version 27 performance items in three groups: application, development and SQL optimization
Application: sorting by Type and Line No. in sales and purchase postings, plus SQL statements in AL profiles
Development: new LockTimeoutDuration, CreateSequentialGuid and Truncate in AL
SQL optimization: flow fields sharing the same table and filters are combined into one OUTER APPLY, which applies automatically
The author ranks this release fourth for performance impact since 23.x and stresses that performance gains are cumulative across versions
features: Sorting by Type and Line No. in Sales and Purchase Postings
Flow Fields optimization with OUTER APPLY

quotes.text: all of the features are CUMULATIVE, hence the latest version is always the fastest on the market
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies that performance improvements stack across versions, meaning adopting the latest release automatically provides cumulative benefits
